summary: Closed all four gate gaps on phase/006-P4: published-version immutability is now enforced against git in both halves (working tree and history), tests/publish.sh repacks through tools/package-chart.sh (which gained an optional destination argument), the consumer fixture renders the ceph helpers' TF-owned-PV branch and the claimName override, and .gitignore covers what a hand-run `helm dependency update tests/consumer` writes. kc project lint, test and build are green from the repo root, and every new assertion was confirmed to bite by mutating the thing it defends — including the P2 reviewer's exact previously-green rewrite sequence. Nothing the repo publishes changed: dist/, Dockerfile, Jenkinsfile, the manifest and HelmCharts are untouched.
